skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Ready to Go
skins.content: MARTHE New Arrivals/Ready to Go. Inspired by traditional Ursus school uniforms, this season's most successful iteration is fine-tuned to capture the trends of today's youth. Top seller in Ursus.
skins.quote: The right temperament and clothing converge in just the perfect manner.

skins.name: Ursus IO79
skins.content: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Ursus IO79. A black and red base. A compact design, drawing from casual accessories to give a boost to color variety, bringing about a brand new fashion experience.
skins.quote: The Ursus people never hide their leading views on fashion trends.
